files.patch:
@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@ on:
   pull_request:
 
 jobs:
-  verify:
+  test-fast:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     steps:
       - name: Checkout
@@ -21,8 +21,50 @@ jobs:
       - name: Install dependencies
         run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
 
-      - name: Verify
-        run: bun run verify
+      - name: Lint and typecheck
+        run: bun run lint && bun run check
+
+      - name: Build
+        run: bun run build
+
+      - name: Run deterministic test lane
+        run: bun test tests --timeout 20000
+
+  test-contracts:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Setup Bun
+        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+        with:
+          bun-version: 1.3.11
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Run contract tests
+        run: bun test tests/contracts --timeout 20000
+
+  test-real-vcs:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    env:
+      CX_RUN_REAL_VCS: "1"
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Setup Bun
+        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+        with:
+          bun-version: 1.3.11
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Run real VCS integration tests
+        run: bun test tests/vcs/provider.real.integration.test.ts --timeout 20000
 
   repomix-matrix:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
@@ -53,6 +95,8 @@ jobs:
 
   bundle-update-matrix:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    needs:
+      - test-fast
     strategy:
       matrix:
         transition: [style-change, section-change, asset-change]
